text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I did it! I won, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking about giving it my 
all, pushing forward... and before I knew 
it, I'd already blown past the finish 
line.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Ehehe, I really did take 1st place in the 
race, didn't I?
choice_data_list: Don't let your guard down, you hear.
You mustn't let your guard down.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I was already happy just to win, 
but getting praised makes me even happier!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I'll write about today in Mom's letter 
too. ...Hehe."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We won today, but who knows what will 
happen in the next race, so I need to stay 
focused!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for pointing that out! I'll keep 
doing my best!
